name: hud_ui_load_game_dialog_on_primary_action
description: HudUiLoadGameDialog::OnPrimaryAction exits the save/load transition when the game-name input is empty, otherwise creates the SavedGames directory, optionally confirms overwrite of an existing path, repeatedly attempts ZBD load entries, deletes failed save files, and queues transition exit.
known_limits: Binary Ninja reconstruction remains limited by inherited HUD dialog/source-file naming debt and dependent limited callees HudUi::ShowMessageBox and HudUiSaveLoadDialog::DeleteSaveFile.

The native smoke covers the empty-name branch that queues QueueExitCurrentState(0). Filesystem, message-box, retry, and ZBD archive branches are source-reviewed against Binary Ninja and backed by functional coverage on their direct callees, but not all are independently driven by this smoke.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD save/load dialog class pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation and assembly for 0x435240 validate HudUiNumericTextInput::GetBuffer, empty/null input exit, _mkdir("SavedGames"), sprintf("SavedGames\\%s"), existing-file confirmation with zLoc ids 136 and 137, ZBD_LoadEntriesGlobal retry, DeleteSaveFile(0), failure message id 140, cancel return 2, and final QueueExitCurrentState(0).
The native smoke constructs a load-game dialog with an empty game-name input, calls OnPrimaryAction, and validates the queued RecoilApp_StateQueueKind_ExitCurrent item with param 0.
